items.source: When asynchronous handling completes, the request is dispatched to the container for further processing. At this stage the DispatcherServlet invokes preHandle, postHandle, and afterCompletion. To distinguish between the initial request and the subsequent dispatch after asynchronous handling completes, interceptors can check whether the jakarta.servlet.DispatcherType of ServletRequest is "REQUEST" or "ASYNC".
items.translation: 当异步处理完成后，请求被分派到容器进行进一步处理。在此阶段，`DispatcherServlet` 会调用 `preHandle`、`postHandle` 和 `afterCompletion`。为了区分初始请求与异步处理完成后的后续分派，拦截器可以检查 `ServletRequest` 的 `jakarta.servlet.DispatcherType` 是 `"REQUEST"` 还是 `"ASYNC"`。

items.source: Note that HandlerInterceptor implementations may need to do work when an async request times out or completes with a network error. For such cases the Servlet container does not dispatch and therefore the postHandle and afterCompletion methods will not be invoked. Instead, interceptors can register to track an asynchronous request through the registerCallbackInterceptor and registerDeferredResultInterceptor methods on WebAsyncManager. This can be done proactively on every request from preHandle regardless of whether async request processing will start.
items.translation: 注意，当异步请求超时或因网络错误完成时，`HandlerInterceptor` 实现可能需要执行操作。对于此类情况，Servlet 容器不会进行分派，因此 `postHandle` 和 `afterCompletion` 方法将不会被调用。相反，拦截器可以通过 WebAsyncManager 上的 `registerCallbackInterceptor` 和 `registerDeferredResultInterceptor` 方法注册以跟踪异步请求。这可以在每个请求的 `preHandle` 中主动进行，无论是否启动异步请求处理。

items.source: When a handler starts an asynchronous request, the DispatcherServlet exits without invoking postHandle and afterCompletion as it normally does for a synchronous request, since the result of request handling (for example, ModelAndView) is likely not yet ready and will be produced concurrently from another thread. In such scenarios, afterConcurrentHandlingStarted(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse, Object) is invoked instead, allowing implementations to perform tasks such as cleaning up thread-bound attributes before releasing the thread to the Servlet container.
items.translation: 当处理器启动异步请求时，DispatcherServlet 会退出，而不会像处理同步请求那样调用 postHandle 和 afterCompletion，因为请求处理的结果（例如 ModelAndView）可能尚未准备好，将由另一个线程并发产生。在此类场景中，将调用 afterConcurrentHandlingStarted(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse, Object)，从而允许实现执行诸如清理线程绑定属性之类的任务，然后再将线程释放给 Servlet 容器。

items.source:
Implementations may use the provided request and response but should
avoid modifying them in ways that would conflict with the concurrent
execution of the handler. A typical use of this method would be to
clean up thread-local variables.
items.translation: 实现可以使用提供的请求和响应，但应避免以与处理程序并发执行冲突的方式对其进行修改。此方法的典型用途是清理线程局部变量。

items.source: handler - the handler (or HandlerMethod) that started async execution, for type and/or instance examination
items.translation: `handler` - 启动异步执行的处理器（或HandlerMethod），用于类型和/或实例检查

items.source: Called instead of postHandle and afterCompletion when the handler is being executed concurrently.
items.translation: 在处理器并发执行时，代替调用postHandle和afterCompletion。

items.source: Exception - in case of errors
items.translation: Exception - 在发生错误时
